column3: Set the pace from the start - pushed along with 2f left and finished strongly - drew away inside the final 75 yards to score
Handy in the pack - pushed along and lacking extra pace over 1f out - stayed on inside final furlong but held by winner close home
Settled towards the back - pushed along wide from 2f out but couldn't reach the leaders - stayed on to finish third
Raced handy - pushed along with 2f left and squeezed for space inside final furlong - stayed on to finish fourth beaten 2¾ lengths
Handy early behind front group - made ground near the rail approaching final furlong - held no more inside the last - finished fifth
Settled just off the pace - lost ground approaching final furlong - dropped away close home to finish sixth
Slow to break - held up towards the back throughout - never a factor - finished seventh
Tracked the front pair early - roused into contention approaching 2f out - swept through inside the final furlong to hit the front - stayed on strongly to win
Went straight to front - pressed for effort a furlong out and gave up advantage inside the final furlong - unable to find more late and held for second
Tracked pace-setter early - pushed along to close in from just past the furlong marker - kept going strongly to get up close home
Went straight to front - urged forward with 3f left - driven and challenged inside final furlong - stayed on well but caught close to the line

Pulled hard early - sat handy in third - drifted left when asked to quicken 2f out - squeezed for space approaching the furlong marker then drifted right and found little - lost ground steadily inside the final furlong to finish third
Sluggish start - held up at the back throughout - never a threat - finished fourth
Settled towards the back of the pack early - lacked the pace to go with the front group and dropped away in the closing stages - finished fifth
Sluggish start - held towards back - urged forward with 3f left but made no dent on leaders - dropped away in closing stages
Held a spot near the front early - dropped away outside 2f out - trailed home in 7th

Drifted right at the off - held second spot early - pushed into command a furlong out - overtaken inside the last and unable to fight back
Fought for an early pull - went to front - pressed into stick and passed inside final 2f - dropped away to finish well held
Slow to get going - settled towards the back - found little room to progress a furlong out - darted right for space - accelerated strongly to get up close home
Held a forward position early - driven and drifted right approaching final two furlongs - hit front inside last furlong and battled on - caught close to line for second
Set the pace early - pressed for effort and lost the front spot inside the last two furlongs - stayed on to hold third close home
Tracked the pace group early - pushed along a furlong out - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish 4th beaten a length and a quarter
Pulled hard early - tracked pace before drifting right and being steered left over 1f out - couldn't quicken and held for fifth
Tracked the pace - lost touch inside final 2f - finished well to close late gap
Held up in the pack - nudged into contention approaching final furlong on the far side - unable to close further - finished 7th beaten 3¾ lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along 2f out with no progress made - dropped away over 1f out to finish eighth

Set the pace early - pressed for effort and overtaken approaching final furlong then rekindled a strong late effort - flattened out near line to finish third

Sluggish start - settled at the back - made steady progress to join the front group 2f out - urged forward with a furlong left - driven inside the final furlong - kept on at an even effort to finish 4th
Tracked leaders on the rail - urged forward 3f out then lost pace 2f out - dropped away final furlong to finish 5th

Went straight to the front - pressed for effort and lost the lead inside the final two furlongs - dropped away close home - finished fifth beaten 5.5 lengths
Handy in the early stages - hit the front over 2f out and stayed on strongly - clear at the finish
Set the pace early - lost the front spot with over 2f left - unable to close final 110 yards - held on for second

Tracked the pace on the rail - squeezed for room approaching 2f out and eased right - moved into third with another shift right inside the final furlong - unable to threaten out front and held for 3rd
Hampered start - settled wide with leading group - pressed for effort 2f out but held final stretch to finish 4th
Sat close to the front - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong
Held up towards the back - lost touch two out - no impression late - finished sixth

Sat just behind the front group - closed on the pace two out and edged in front approaching the final furlong - driven out to hold on to the finish

Handy near front - pushed for effort with 2f left - lost ground a furlong out then finished 4th steady to the line
Settled with the pack early - urged forward before 3f out then edged left under pressure 2f out - unable to gain on the leaders finishing fifth

Held up towards the back - dropped away inside final furlong - finished eighth
Set the pace from the off - pushed along two furlongs out and edge narrowed approaching the last furlong - overtaken with fifty yards left - fought back to prevail on the line

Settled in the pack early - pushed along with two furlongs left - kept going at one tempo but never reached the front rank - finished fourth beaten 4 lengths

Settled at the back early - failed to find a rhythm - asked for effort after 2f and toiling from 3f out - well held at the finish
Held up handy early - stalking the front pack with 4f left - pushed along 3f out - soon toiling and beaten home
Sat close to the pace early - still up with the front markers 5f out - pushed along with 2f left before fading into the finish
Held up in the pack early - unable to improve position - well held in 11th

Held a forward spot early - drifted towards the wide part of the track after the opening furlong then crossed over to link with the rest of the field 4f out - pushed along 2f out - dropped away soon after finishing well held
Held up early - shipped ground to leaders steadily - well behind with three furlongs left - finished well held in 13th
Drifted right at the off - set the pace throughout - opened daylight inside final furlong - kept going strongly to win easily

Settled just off the pace - pushed along inside final furlong and edged closer - kept going late but never a threat to leaders
Tracked no rivals on far flank early - hit front before being overtaken inside final furlong - dropped to sixth without responding late
Settled towards the back early - pushed along and lost touch approaching final 3f - moved through tired horses late but no real threat throughout - finished 7th
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with a furlong to go - unable to find further response - finished well beaten in 8th
Settled in the pack early - urged forward two furlongs out - unable to respond and beaten off - finished ninth
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - failed to close down leaders - well held in 10th
Settled towards the back early - pushed along with 2f left - unable to make an impact and finished well beaten
Settled just off the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - faded quickly to finish well back in 12th
Handy early - hit front with over 2f left - held on well to the line to score

Handy with the front pack early - moved right approaching final 2f - pushed along inside the last furlong - stayed on well through the closing stages - grabbed second on the line - beaten a half-length

Held towards the rear of the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - stayed on at same tempo through the closing stages - finished fourth beaten 4¼ lengths
Handy early - pressed for effort with 2f left - eased back through the field inside the final furlong - finished 5th

Settled in the pack early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away quickly after - eventually held in 7th

Held a middle position early - pressed for a run but lost ground 2f out - fought back to close late and finish fourth

Held mid-pack early - pressed for effort 2f out - unable to close - beaten home well held in 8th
Settled towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - no impression made - finished ninth well behind

Sent to the front early - lost the advantage inside the final 2f - dropped away quickly through the closing stages - well held at the line
Handy early - pushed to the front over a furlong out - drew away inside final furlong - won easily

Sent to front early - driven up and overtaken with more than a furlong left - stayed on late but edged out for second near the line to finish third
Held handy spot early - pressed for effort and slipped back over 2f out - stayed on without gaining finished 4th beaten 4.5 lengths
Settled in the pack - driven up to press for third with 2f left - weakened in the last furlong to finish 5th

Drifted right early - settled midfield - pressed for effort 2f out - stayed on final furlong to take second close home - narrowly denied

Fought for control early - clear in front until overtaken inside final furlong - lost momentum close home to finish 5th
Fighting the bridle early - tracked the front group - pressed for effort with 2f left before dropping away final furlong to finish 6th

Held mid-pack early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - well beaten in 8th

Settled at the back early - looking for space two out and squeezed for room approaching the furlong marker - found room and finished strongly late but unable to get to the front pair

Held up early - moved into contention and drifted left approaching last 2f - hit front inside final furlong but caught close home

Drifted slightly left at the off before going in front - lost the advantage 2f out - squeezed for space inside final furlong and stayed on for 4th

Settled in rear early - crept closer to front pair by 2f out - hit front approaching final furlong under urging - stayed on well to the line

Drifted right early - fought for control in front rank - hit the front - lost advantage 3f out - dropped away final furlong
Fired up early - bumped at the off - settled last - urged forward before 3f out - driven with 2f left - well beaten finishing well adrift
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - set the pace throughout - given encouragement two out and driven approaching the final furlong - stayed on to score
Held up towards the back - moved right and made progress from 2f out - closed on the leader inside the final furlong without getting there - stayed on to finish second by half a length
Held up early - urged into progress from 2f out to move into third inside final furlong - stayed on to finish third beaten 1 1/4 lengths
Drifted left at the off - sat behind the front group before being ridden over 2f out - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish 4th

Handy in the leading group - pushed along approaching final 2f - driven with a furlong left - closed strongly late to share the win

Set the pace early - pushed along and drifted left approaching the final furlong and a half - overtaken close home - kept responding to the line for third
pulling hard early - tracked close order - urged forward with a furlong left - unable to close on the front-runners inside the last - stayed on for fourth

Sluggish start - settled at the back - made progress up the outside 3f out - drifted left inside final 2f then held no more late gain
Early on handy but pulling hard - jostled with 4f left - dropped away with 2f to run - well held at the finish

Set the pace early - bumped 4f out then lost front spot 3f out - drifted left final furlong and faded out of contention
Sat behind the front two - pushed along 2f out and moving through inside the final furlong - hit the front close home - stayed on strongly to win

Went straight to front - pushed along 2f out - driven inside final furlong - overtaken close home - unable to find more and held for third
Handy early - pushed for effort with over 2f left but couldn't find extra inside final furlong - stayed on at one gait to finish fourth
Held up at the rear - losing touch approaching final 2f - well held at the finish
Set the pace from the off - nudged for effort with 2f remaining - stayed on strongly through the closing stages to score
Fought for control early - sat close to leader before being asked for effort over a furlong out - couldn't get on terms inside final stages - beaten a length into second
Sat behind the pace - urged forward with over two furlongs remaining - stayed on inside final furlong but unable to close on the leading duo

Checked shortly after the off and settled near the back - never troubled the front - finished sixth well beaten
Hampered start and lost ground quickly - stayed towards the back - never a factor - finished 7th
Settled in the pack early - dropped away past the 4f marker - trailed home in the closing stages

Pulled hard early - settled at the rear - moved left approaching 2f out - showed inexperience but surged into contention entering the last furlong - driven to the front close home and stayed on strongly to score

Held a forward position early - roused into contention with 2f left - disputed for the advantage inside the final furlong and edged in front for a stride - kept trying but couldn't match the winner's finishing speed - held on for second beaten a half length
Drifted right early - handy with the front group - urged on approaching 2f out - driven out inside final furlong - kept on to finish third
Set the pace early - pushed for effort with a couple of furlongs left - pressed for more approaching the last furlong - overtaken close home and faded to finish fourth
Sat behind front group early - pushed for effort with just over a furlong left - lost ground close home - finished 5th

Pushed on early - urged into contention 3f out - lost lead 2f out - fought back inside final furlong - closing fast but denied by a whisker
Sat close behind pace-setter until inside final 2f - lost ground close home - eventually finished third

Held up towards the back - pushed along and gained ground under two furlongs out - pressed on inside the final furlong to move into second - stayed on strongly - denied by a whisker
